description: This file defines the internal class NatsQueueAdapterReceiver which implements IQueueAdapterReceiver for handling message receiving and processing via NATS in Orleans streaming. It manages connection setup, message retrieval, deserialization, and acknowledgment within the NATS streaming provider context.

classes.name: NatsQueueAdapterReceiver
classes.description: Implements the IQueueAdapterReceiver interface to support message receiving and acknowledgment for NATS streaming in Orleans. Handles initialization, shutdown, message retrieval, deserialization, and delivery acknowledgment.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new NatsQueueAdapterReceiver with provided configuration parameters.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the consumer connection with a specified timeout.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the receiver, completing pending tasks.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of messages up to maxCount, deserializes them, and returns as a list of IBatchContainer.

methods.name: MessagesDeliveredAsync
methods.description: Acknowledges the messages that have been processed, allowing NATS to mark them as delivered.
